title: PPA agent policy
description: What an agent is allowed to do. The autonomy_level enum lists every level the system can NAME; which of them are ACTIVATED is a separate question answered by _ppa/agent_policy.ACTIVATED_LEVEL, because a schema that only allowed the activated level would have to be edited to raise autonomy, and editing a schema is a smaller act than editing the gate. A document may therefore be schema-valid and still refused by validate_policy, and that is the intended split: the schema says what is well-formed, the program says what is permitted.

autonomy_level.description: B0 replay-only; A0 explain-only; A1 preview; A2 bounded action; A3 closed-loop with rollback. Staged activation order, spec 4.9.1.

allow_list.description: Named capabilities the agent may use. Empty at A0, where there is nothing to use.

blast_radius.description: At A0 every field here must be zero or empty. Not because the fields are unused, but because a document describing a capability the level does not have is the document somebody later reads as permission.

budget.description: Budget accounting is never delegated (spec 4.6); these are the numbers a program enforces, not ones an agent reasons about.

never_delegated.description: Questions no agent decides at any level. A document listing FEWER than the closed set is refused: the narrowing is the interesting edit.
